description: Save the brand you drafted during setup. Send the whole brand each time: it replaces the saved one. Set confirmed to true only after the user agreed to your summary.

brand.description: The whole brand. Send every part each time: what is left out is cleared, except the parts the user set by hand (brand.owned), which are kept.

audience.description: Who buys, in a sentence or two, up to 600 characters.

description.description: What the business does, up to 600 characters.

hours.description: Opening hours in words, up to 300 characters.

languages.description: The languages it posts in, up to 5, each up to 40 characters.

location.description: The town or neighbourhood, up to 80 characters.

name.description: Required. The name of the business, up to 80 characters.

phone.description: The phone number customers call, up to 40 characters.

serviceArea.description: Where it serves, up to 200 characters.

hours.description: That day’s hours as { open, close } in 24-hour times, null for closed, or a list of up to three { open, close } for a day that opens more than once.

label.description: What the day is, up to 40 characters.

special.description: Days that differ from the usual week, up to 30: a holiday, a closure or a late night. Powers the live Open/Closed status on link pages.

trade.description: Required. What kind of business it is, up to 60 characters, such as "auto shop" or "restaurant". setup_start lists the trades the templates know.

website.description: Its web address, starting with https://, up to 200 characters.

week.description: Opening hours day by day, keyed mon to sun: { open, close } as 24-hour times such as "08:30", null for closed, or a list of up to three { open, close } for a day that opens more than once. A day left out is not stated.

business.description: Required. Who the business is and how to reach it.

confirmed.description: True only once the user has agreed to your summary of the brand.

goal.description: What the business wants more of from its posts, in one line of up to 200 characters: calls, bookings, walk-ins, orders. A post’s call to action leads there.

hashtags.description: Hashtags it uses, up to 30, each up to 60 characters.

about.description: One line about it, up to 240 characters.

name.description: Required. The product, service or dish, up to 80 characters.

price.description: Its price as the user writes it, such as "$89" or "from $45", up to 24 characters. Leave it out unless the user gave it.

items.description: What the business sells, up to 60.

caption.description: What the photo shows, up to 160 characters.

cutout.description: True for a photo that stands alone: cut out, or shot on white. The cover page takes these.

item.description: The item it belongs to, by name, up to 80 characters.

mediaId.description: Required. The media id of an uploaded picture.

library.description: Photos of the business’s own work, up to 200. A photo is kept in storage for as long as it is listed here.

colors.description: The four colours templates are drawn in. One left out keeps its default.

body.description: The Google Fonts family for text. Left out, it follows display.

display.description: The Google Fonts family for headings, such as "Archivo".

fonts.description: The type templates are set in, by family name.

logo.description: The media id of the uploaded logo.

look.description: The colours, type and logo that templates are drawn in.

never.description: Things no post may say, up to 20 lines of up to 240 characters: prices that are not public, claims that cannot be shown.

offers.description: What it offers right now, up to 20 lines of up to 160 characters.

what.description: Required. What was taken from it, up to 200 characters.

where.description: Required. A web address, or "the customer", up to 200 characters.

sources.description: Where each part of the brand came from, up to 20, so the user can see it was read and not made up.

templates.description: The template chosen for each format, such as { "carousel": "rundown" }, for up to 12 formats. Ids come from templates_list.

topics.description: What the business posts about, up to 20 lines of up to 120 characters.

avoid.description: What its writing avoids, up to 10 lines of up to 200 characters.

do.description: What its writing does, up to 10 lines of up to 200 characters.

sample.description: One passage in the business’s own voice, up to 600 characters.

tone.description: Up to 8 words for how it sounds, each up to 40 characters.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

name: brand_save
title: Save the brand
